table.retrieve:
SELECT
	item.customicode,
	srdetail.alternatecustomicode,
	currlistrow = 0, 
	srdetail.icode,
	srdetail.returnitemdescription, 
	item.name,
	srdetail.batch, 
	srdetail.expiry, 
	srdetail.avgprice,   
	srdetail.newavgprice,
	srdetail.srinvcode,    
	srdetail.gcode,    
	srdetail.packqty, 
	srdetail.packunits, 
	srdetail.srprice, 
	srdetail.salestax, 
	srdetail.salerowid,
	stock = 0.0000, 
	packingdesc=space(50),
	totalstock = 0.0000, 
	retableqty = 0.0000, 
	saleqty = 0.0000, 
	retablebonusqty = 0.0000, 
	salebonusqty = 0.0000, 
	srdetail.discperc,
	srdetail.SrUtn,
	srdetail.unitsalestax,
	srdetail.gstperc,
	srdetail.saleprice,
	srdetail.TotalPieces,
	srdetail.PiecesInHand,
	srdetail.CommissionPerc,
	srdetail.CommissionPerUnit,
	srdetail.alternatepurprice,
	bonusqty=srdetail.bonusqty,
	srdetail.looseqty   
FROM 
	srdetail,   
	item  
WHERE 
	( srdetail.icode = item.icode ) and  
	(dbo.srdetail.srinvcode = :ra_salesretinvno )

objects.name: c_detaildwtotal
objects.expression: sum(( ( looseqty *  srprice  )  +   ( packqty *  srprice * packunits ) ) *  ( 1-  (  discperc  *  .01 )) for all )

objects.name: c_itemtotal
objects.expression: (  ( looseqty *  srprice  )  +   ( packqty *  srprice * packunits ) ) *  ( 1-  (  discperc  *  .01 )  )
